rationale.usefulness: The seven primary captures support a concrete escalation-model evaluation: actual model ID and modality, effort differences, preserved-thinking migration, advisor prerequisites, retention and full-session billing. The proposed education, repository, website and edit-planning pilots have inspectable outputs and failure criteria. Utility is high for hard technical work, while ordinary tasks may be better served by cheaper models and no pilot was executed.
rationale.impact: The release is a substantial general technical-capability advance, supported as a vendor report by broad coding, scientific, robotic and sustained multi-agent demonstrations and improvements over Fable 5.1. General hosted Fable availability and a 20 percent reduction in base token rates make the potential significance broader than a narrow research preview. An 8 reflects that potential, not proven field-wide productivity: conditions differ across benchmarks, formalization used about 1,000 agents, some AI-development capabilities are deliberately limited, and independent replication is absent.
rationale.novelty: The documented combination of stronger long-running technical work, stricter preserved-thinking behavior and differentiated Fable/Mythos access is meaningfully distinctive. The demonstrations suggest new practical reach, but neither a novel underlying architecture nor an independently established general breakthrough is shown; the report correctly avoids treating benchmark rows as a uniform model ranking.
rationale.maturity: Active model status, explicit platform IDs, detailed request constraints, pricing and documented migration/error behavior support a usable hosted release. A score of 7 remains below demonstrated dependability because access varies by feature, advisor is experimental, Enterprise Frontier Safeguards is private beta, the system card was not inspected, and no runtime or reliability test was conducted.
rationale.openness: Public documentation and inspectable API contracts aid integration, but the inspected route is a proprietary hosted service without downloadable weights or a local license. Commercial restrictions, account-bound thinking, verification-controlled Mythos access and model-specific retention constrain portability and reproducibility.
